dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000re2g](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000re2g) Magnitude 6.6 earthquake at 25.388 depth occurred on Nov 27 2025 13km NE of Amarabu. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 2.6921 longitude 96.0266. It impacted 37049 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
